note: Views integration for Content Sync's cms_content_sync_entity_status records: Views field/filter plugins, a DER base field, and three system.action VBO configs (export_status_entity 'Force Push', import_status_entity, reset_status_entity of type cms_content_sync_entity_status). Hard dependency of cms_content_sync_health, so the module is NOT toggled in these cases. Medium introspects the shipped action config; hard creates a namespaced action config entity reusing the module's export_status_entity plugin. No sync backend needed.

evals.prompt: What does cms_content_sync_views provide, and which extra contrib module does it require (and why)?
evals.expected_output: It provides a Views integration over Content Sync's cms_content_sync_entity_status records (Views fields, filters and bulk actions). It requires dynamic_entity_reference because the status entity references many entity types from one table, so a DER base field is needed for Views to join to the referenced entity.

evals.prompt: cms_content_sync_views installs bulk-operation actions on sync-status records. Name the three actions it ships (their machine ids or what they do).
evals.expected_output: export_status_entity (label 'Force Push', push), import_status_entity (pull) and reset_status_entity (reset) - system.action config entities of type cms_content_sync_entity_status, backed by PushStatusEntity/PullStatusEntity/ResetStatusEntity action plugins.

evals.prompt: Name some of the Views field or filter plugins that cms_content_sync_views adds for building sync-status listings.
evals.expected_output: Field plugins: SyncState, PoolLabel, FlowLabel, EntityTypeLabel, ParentEntity, RenderedFlags. Filter plugins: SyncState, EntityType, Flags, Flow, Pool. Registered via hook_views_data_alter.

evals.prompt: On this site, cms_content_sync_views is enabled. Inspect the live configuration of its 'export_status_entity' action and report that action's label.
evals.expected_output: The action system.action.export_status_entity has label 'Force Push' (drush cget system.action.export_status_entity label).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a bulk-operation action (system.action config entity) with machine id 'ccs_views_task_action' and label 'CCS Task Force Push' that reuses the Content Sync Views force-push action plugin. It must target the sync-status entity: set the action type to cms_content_sync_entity_status and its plugin to export_status_entity. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A system.action config entity ccs_views_task_action exists with type cms_content_sync_entity_status and plugin export_status_entity, e.g. Action::create(['id'=>'ccs_views_task_action','label'=>'CCS Task Force Push','type'=>'cms_content_sync_entity_status','plugin'=>'export_status_entity','configuration'=>[]])->save().
